sources: Twenge, Sherman & Wells (2017). Declines in sexual frequency among American adults, 1989-2014. Archives of Sexual Behavior 46(8). GSS, N > 26,000; ~9 fewer times/year in 2010-2014 vs 1995-1999; married/cohabiting ~16 fewer times/year vs 2000-2004; fewer steady partners among younger cohorts. Via Phys.org 2017.
